To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) transformation knowledge can be incorporated into kernels in different ways; (2) these ways differ in their representation of the transformation manifold and in the way they can be used; (3) the most flexible and general method, transformation integration kernels, is positive definite, whereas the other methods are not positive definite; (4) the positive definite method is the most flexible one, as it can be used for any kind of transformations; (5) the non-positive definite methods are more efficient,

(1) the transformation integration kernels are not positive definite and hence not usable in kernel methods (2) the tangent distance kernels are positive definite and hence usable in kernel methods, but the resulting kernel is not invariant under the transformation, and (3) the invariant distance substitution kernels are positive definite (and hence also usable in kernel methods), but the kernel does not depend on the transformation.
the transformation knowledge can be incorporated in a kernel function in different ways.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of kernel functions for incorporating specific transformation knowledge in pattern analysis and machine learning.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TD-kernel is a very efficient and powerful method for incorporating transformation knowledge in kernel functions.
all three types of transformation kernels are valuable and useful for certain tasks.
the TI-kernels are theoretically the best ones as they are positive definite and the transformation extent is fully adjustable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we were able to show that transformation knowledge can be incorporated in a very flexible way in kernel methods, that the resulting kernels are useful in many practical situations and that they can be computed efficiently.
transformation knowledge in the form of transformations of the patterns can be incorporated into kernel functions in a very flexible and efficient manner.
we have presented a new class of kernels that is based on the incorporation of transformation knowledge.
